'''Zalaren''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] doctor living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]] he was on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], working as a researcher on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]-backed [[Project Quell]], designed to study the weaknesses of the [[Rakghoul]]s. When a power surge shut down the security in the facility located in [[Tularan Marsh]], the rakghouls burst out and attacked the scientists. Zalaren managed to hide until the reinforcements arrived and was the only survivor of the incident in the lab.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Doctor Zalaren appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the heroic mission "Rakghoul Release" on Taris.<ref name="SWTOR" />
